title: The Episode About Wazir Khan's Murder

blocks.text: In the next major battle the field fills with smoke, dust, and fear, and many camp-followers, robbers, and noncombatants started deserting as the pressure from Wazir Khan’s well-supplied army grows.
Banda’s side appears materially weak by comparison, yet the page stresses that divine support and resolve can overturn what looks like a purely worldly imbalance.
The tone is one of gathering crisis: the Mughal side seems stronger in resources, but the moral and spiritual terms of the battle are moving in the Khalsa’s favor.
